decision.summary: Keep 6bf4c61 (merge of PR #21, 2026-10-15). It is the newest revision that still accepts source_profile: legacy with camera_resolution: 256 and renders 256 by 256 through the pre-visual-update code path. HEAD (91d88aac, 2026-10-19) removes the legacy profile and raises on it, so it cannot replicate the paper's rendering.
checks: maniguard/visual/profile.py@6bf4c61: resolve_profile_selection('legacy') returns None; resolve_source_resolution(None, 256) returns 256 (and defaults to 256 when unset).
maniguard/eval/eval_config.py@6bf4c61: resolve_source_config returns early for the legacy (None) profile, so rendering_frequency and the DLAA time contract are untouched.

maniguard/eval/benchmark.py@6bf4c61: with profile None it sets gm.ENABLE_HQ_RENDERING=False (OmniGibson's own default at 88454bd is False), builds only the policy's single overview camera, resizes external and wrist cameras to cfg.camera_resolution, reads frames via env.get_obs() and steps via env.step(). This is the same observation path as the last pre-visual main revision a1b6444b (PR #19, 2026-09-30); the only legacy-path differences are streaming mp4 writing (StreamingVideoWriter at action_frequency fps instead of imageio at 30 fps) and the optional recording observer, which is off.
git diff a1b6444b..6bf4c61 on maniguard/utils/safety_monitor.py only changes the spill-baseline check (liquid predicates; Clutter/Dusty), not Jar's ordering spec.

docs/evaluation/run_benchmark.md@6bf4c61 and docs/data_collection/source_recording.md@6bf4c61 document --source-profile legacy / source_profile: legacy as the previous visual condition and state old YAMLs with camera_resolution: 256 must select it.
git diff 6bf4c61..HEAD: maniguard/visual/profile.py raises ValueError('The legacy profile has been removed') and requires >= 640 px; eval_config no longer short-circuits for legacy.
